title: Every validation error, and what to do about it

questions.q: The message is 'Prompt outputs failed validation' with empty details. Where is the real error?
options: In node_errors, under the node at fault
questions.answer: In node_errors, under the node at fault
questions.why: The wrapper only lists reasons from the output node itself. Upstream faults are in node_errors.

questions.q: A broken node sits on a branch that leads to no output. What do you see?
options: No error: it is never checked
questions.answer: No error: it is never checked
questions.why: validate_inputs walks back from the outputs and never reaches it.

questions.q: Exception when validating inner node: '99'. What does the 99 mean?
options: A wire points at node 99, which isn't in the graph
questions.answer: A wire points at node 99, which isn't in the graph
questions.why: It is the text of a KeyError from prompt[o_id]. We triggered it with a dangling wire.

questions.q: A graph has two outputs, and one has a broken input. What does the server do?
options: Runs the good output and reports the other
questions.answer: Runs the good output and reports the other
questions.why: The prompt fails only if no output is left. A real run showed outputs ['2'] with node_errors filled.

questions.q: A missing file in LoadImage appears as which type?
questions.why: LoadImage's VALIDATE_INPUTS returns a string: Invalid image file: nothing_here.png.

questions.q: Your graph passes validation, and then fails on a size mismatch. Why wasn't that caught?
options: Validation doesn't run nodes, so it can't know sizes
Sizes are only checked on a GPU
questions.answer: Validation doesn't run nodes, so it can't know sizes
questions.why: It compares declared types and constant values. Tensor sizes exist only during the run.
